name: Queen's Gambit Declined
description: Hold the centre with …d5 and …e6, develop quietly and castle: the classical answer to the Queen's Gambit.

lines.name: Tartakower (7…b6)

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.7: …Be7 breaks the pin on the f6 knight.

lines.summary: The Orthodox QGD: …Be7, castle, …h6, then …b6 and …Bb7 to solve the problem bishop.

lines.name: Tartakower: 8.cxd5

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.7: …Be7 breaks the pin on the f6 knight.
notes.15: …Nxd5 trades pieces to free Black's game.

lines.summary: After cxd5, take back with the knight and trade pieces; then …Bb7 and …c5.

lines.name: 4.Nf3 Be7 5.Bf4

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.11: …b6 prepares …Bb7 and …c5, the plan of the Tartakower.

lines.summary: Against Bf4, castle and play …b6 and …Bb7, or hit the centre with …c5.

lines.name: Exchange (4.cxd5)

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.11: …O-O: Black has a solid position; White usually plans the minority attack.

lines.summary: In the Exchange, develop …Be7 and castle; …c6, …Nbd7 and …Re8 make a solid set-up.

lines.name: Exchange: 7.Bd3

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.11: …O-O: Black has a solid position; White usually plans the minority attack.
notes.13: …h6 asks the g5 bishop to make a decision before Black finishes developing.

lines.summary: Against Bd3, ask the bishop with …h6, then …c6, …Nbd7 and …Re8.

lines.name: 4.e3

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.9: …O-O: the solid set-up again; …b6 or …c5 next.

lines.summary: Against the quiet 4.e3, develop with …Be7 and castle.

lines.name: 4.Bf4

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.

lines.summary: Against 4.Bf4, develop and castle; …c5 is a good way to hit back.

lines.name: Catalan (4.g3)

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.11: …dxc4 takes the pawn now that White has castled; Black plays …a6 and …b5 or …c5 next.

lines.summary: Against the Catalan, develop and castle, then take on c4 and hold the pawn or hit back with …c5.

lines.name: 3.Nf3 move order

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.7: …Be7: the same position as 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Nf3 Be7.

lines.summary: 3.Nf3 and 4.Nc3 reach the normal QGD: develop with …Nf6 and …Be7.

lines.name: 3.cxd5

notes.3: …e6 supports d5 solidly; the price is a passive c8 bishop for now.
notes.7: …Nf6 develops; Bg5 and e3 usually follow.

5.Qxd5: Nc3 gains time on your queen.

lines.summary: After an early cxd5, take back with the pawn and develop …Nf6, …Be7 and castle.
